_comment: Reference only - not imported by index.js. Every error response from the API uses this exact shape. Dev 2 designs a UI state for each code. Dev 1 returns exactly these codes.

codes.whenItHappens: Cognito account exists but email not confirmed

codes.message: Only the team leader can do this.
codes.whenItHappens: Non-leader tries to edit team, invite, or approve/reject

codes.message: You can only edit your own profile.
codes.whenItHappens: Profile PUT by a different user

codes.message: This invitation is not for you.
You are not eligible for this competition.

codes.whenItHappens: Checked when SENDING and again when ACCEPTING

codes.message: You are already in this team.
codes.whenItHappens: Member requests to join own team

codes.message: You already have a pending request to this team.
codes.whenItHappens: Second pending join request to same team

codes.message: This person has already been invited.
codes.whenItHappens: Second pending invite to same person for same team
Bad input - missing field, bad enum, string too long

note: Extraction failure is NOT an error. POST /competitions/analyze returns HTTP 200 with needsReview:true and a list of unextracted fields. See competition-analyze.json.
